title: The Man Who Feared an Empty Table
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original 2D layered motion-comic BACKGROUND for Mochi Mayhem, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536-like. Cute confectionery fantasy, softly painted rich pastel color, crisp dark plum outlines, simple readable storybook shapes, glossy candy highlights, emotional and mysterious rather than horror. This is one full opaque environment only, NOT a mockup, not a comic sheet. Camera: gently elevated frontal theatrical staging so separate boss and Ruby puppets can move over it. Keep centre 45% width around middle 35–66% of canvas fairly empty and flat-lit for moving puppets; place narrative props at left/right and upper half. Bottom 28% is quiet dark plum/soft ground reserved for live Ruby narration. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI, no drawn heroes, no drawn monsters, no bosses baked into the image. No extra mouths or eyes on roots/props. Render a complete polished environment, no empty transparency. Scene: First Tree clearing at twilight. Great ancient tree at back with a SMALL hovering violet-gold crown above its trunk, not destroyed or removed yet. Old empty wooden meal bowls and an unplanted garden bed at lower side edges; a tiny pink-gold heart seed light near exposed roots. Wide centre for First Planter puppet. Emotional theme: fear of famine led to a wish that harmed the kingdom; memory before the existing final ending. NO crown destruction, no giant new tree, no restored human crowd in this background.
